verse.verse_1: When the earth is shaken with its appointed tremor.
verse.verse_2: And the earth throws out its burdens.
verse.verse_3: And man says, “What has happened to it?”
verse.verse_4: On that day earth will narrate its news,
verse.verse_5: Because your Lord sent a command to it.
verse.verse_6: On that day men will return towards their Lord, in different groups, in order to be shown their deeds.
verse.verse_7: So whoever does a good deed equal to the weight of the minutest particle, will see it.
verse.verse_8: And whoever does an evil deed equal to the weight of the minutest particle, will see it.
